must_fix.fix: Keep one line above the table: 'Figures are long-term HNMS station averages, not forecasts, labelled by station.' Move the data-period sentence (line 27) and the Crete/Corfu station notes (lines 32 to 33) into a short 'About these figures' note directly under the table source line (line 53). must_fix.issue: Unit-less Naxos wind figures. Line 101 ('its wind power reading rises from 10.3 in June to 13.3 in July'), line 117 ('the Naxos wind power reading stays high at 13.9'), line 129 ('The Naxos wind power reading peaks for the season at 14.5') and line 139 ('wind power rising from 10.3 in June to 14.5 in October'). Three readers could not tell 'a breeze from a gale'; the sceptic calls a number with no unit unverifiable. fact_09 itself says 'units not stated on the page', so we cannot supply one.
must_fix.fix: Drop the numbers 10.3, 13.3, 13.9 and 14.5 everywhere. Keep only the trend as fact_09 supports it: 'The Naxos station records a prevailing north wind in every month, and its monthly mean wind power is higher from July to October than in May and June.' If the writer keeps any figure, it must say once 'HNMS does not state the unit'. Do not invent a unit, a Beaufort equivalent or effects such as 'blows veils' as fact; the planning consequence already in the draft (sheltered alternative, line 129) stays.

should_fix.issue: The search is answered too late. The Key takeaways open with a station list (line 16, 'Weather in Greece differs by island, so read each figure against its station...') and 'Which months suit your wedding' (line 188) sits near the bottom. Keep station labels in the body. Add one intro line linking to 'Which months suit your wedding' (anchor link), or move that section to sit directly after the table summary (line 55). No single winning month and no 'best' in the body.

should_fix.issue: Santo Wines reads as a wedding season when the source is a tourism opening. The primary persona (medium) asked 'is that a wedding venue or just a cellar door?'; the sceptic (medium) says 'open to tourists all year isn't the same as taking weddings all year'.
should_fix.fix: In line 141, say it as the source states it and add the question: 'Santo Wines in Pyrgos says its Wine Tourism Center is open all year round; that is the centre's opening, not a wedding season, so ask the winery which months it takes weddings.' Remove Santo Wines from the FAQ at line 212.
